title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Campus Solutions → AcademicPeriod
description: Maps Oracle PeopleSoft Campus Solutions term tables to the HELIX AcademicPeriod resource.

source_tables.description: Term definition. Master list of terms with dates and attributes.
Session definitions within terms. Sub-term/session start and end dates.

attribute_mappings.transformation: PeopleSoft STRM follows a 4-digit pattern: first digit = century, second digit = decade/year, third-fourth = term within year. Map: '1'→'spring/semester', '5'→'summer', '9'→'fall/semester'. Derive type from institutional calendar (semester, quarter, etc.).
attribute_mappings.notes: STRM decoding is institution-specific. Common patterns: 2261=Spring 2026, 2265=Summer 2026, 2269=Fall 2026.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to YYYY-YYYY format. PeopleSoft stores as '2026' → '2026-2027' (requires convention mapping).

attribute_mappings.source: PS_SESSION_TBL.CENSUS_DT (for primary session, typically SESSION_CODE = '1' or 'REG')
attribute_mappings.notes: Census date lives at the session level in PeopleSoft, not the term level. Use the primary/regular session.

attribute_mappings.transformation: true if current date is between start_date and end_date
